features.title: Luxury you can feel every day
features.text: Upholstered in high-quality leatherette, the Monarch offers a refined, modern look that’s easy to maintain. Its durable finish resists spills and stains, making it a practical yet elegant choice for daily use.

features.title: Soft embrace with a steady hold
features.text: Designed with a supportive mid-backrest, this sofa provides gentle reinforcement for your spine and shoulders, ensuring proper posture and relaxation whether you’re sitting upright or lounging.

features.title: Comfort that goes the extra mile
features.text: The broad, ergonomically designed armrests provide a natural resting position, reducing strain on your arms while enhancing comfort. Perfect for unwinding with a book or enjoying a quiet moment.

features.title: Gentle bounce, perfect support
features.text: Filled with soft slab stock foam, the cushions offer a plush, sinking feel while maintaining their shape over time. This ensures lasting comfort without compromising on support.

features.title: Raised up for effortless care
features.text: With its elevated PVC legs, the Monarch makes sweeping and vacuuming underneath hassle-free, keeping your space tidy with minimal effort.

features.title: A sofa that adapts to your needs
features.text: The Monarch is designed for versatility, offering modular configurations that let you adjust its layout to suit your space or seating preferences.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
